S.PHON: panaj na miʦaɾiw kis[o|u] t[o|u] pajs[o|u]ʔ i ʦi kaʦawan ħaw
S.TRANSL: Panay, did you borrow money from Kacaw?

S.FORM: Hay, kona anini^ kako a panokas i ciiraan, nika mapawan kako a miala^ to payso^.
Hay, kona anini^ kako a panokas i ciiraan, nika mapawan kako a miala^ to payso^.
S.PHON: ħaj k[o|u]na aniniʔ kak[o|u] a pan[o|u]kas i ʦiiraan nika mapawan kak[o|u] a miaɾaʔ t[o|u] pajs[o|u]ʔ
S.TRANSL: 有，我本來今天要還他，我忘記帶錢了。
Yes, I was supposed to return to him today, but I forgot to bring the money.

S.FORM: Anohacowa^ to aca^ kiso a panokas?
Anohacowa^ to aca^ kiso a panokas?
S.PHON: an[o|u]ħaʦ[o|u]waʔ t[o|u] aʦaʔ kis[o|u] a pan[o|u]kas
S.TRANSL: Then, when will you return the money?

S.FORM: Panokas hato ako i ciiraan anocila^.
Panokas hato ako i ciiraan anocila^.
S.PHON: pan[o|u]kas ħat[o|u] ak[o|u] i ʦiiraan an[o|u]ʦiɾaʔ
S.TRANSL: I will return to him tomorrow.

S.FORM: Hay, pasowal hato ako ci Kacaw.
Hay, pasowal hato ako ci Kacaw.
S.PHON: ħaj pas[o|u]waɾ ħat[o|u] ak[o|u] ʦi kaʦaw
S.TRANSL: Okay, I will tell Kacaw for you.

S.FORM: O ta'eref ko sapilepel to 'edo^, o talakal ko sapilepel to tolok, matira ta matama^.
O ta'eref ko sapilepel to 'edo^, o talakal ko sapilepel to tolok, matira ta matama^.
S.PHON: [o|u] taʡərəf k[o|u] sapiɾəpəɾ t[o|u] ʡə[ɬ|ɮ][o|u]ʔ [o|u] taɾakaɾ k[o|u] sapiɾəpəɾ t[o|u] t[o|u]ɾ[o|u]k matira ta matamaʔ
S.TRANSL: 老鼠應該要⽤⽯壓式陷阱抓，⽵雞應該要⽤套頸式陷阱抓，這樣才對。
It is correct to catch mice through rangay and catch bamboo partridges through qjiulang.

S.FORM: Hilam haenen aca^! Moraraw ko no mako! Onini ko sakacaay pakalepel no mako.
Hilam haenen aca^! Moraraw ko no mako! Onini ko sakacaay pakalepel no mako.
S.PHON: ħiɾam ħaənən aʦaʔ m[o|u]raraw k[o|u] n[o|u] mak[o|u] [o|u]nini k[o|u] sakaʦaaj pakaɾəpəɾ n[o|u] mak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 原來是這樣！我都搞錯了！難怪我都抓不到。
No wonder! I am mistaken and that’s why I cannot catch any of them.

S.FORM: Pasifana'aw haca^ ako kiso a misanga' to matiniay a tosa^ a tilo^.
Pasifana'aw haca^ ako kiso a misanga' to matiniay a tosa^ a tilo^.
S.PHON: pasifanaʡaw ħaʦaʔ ak[o|u] kis[o|u] a misaŋaʡ t[o|u] matiniaj a t[o|u]saʔ a tiɾ[o|u]ʔ
S.TRANSL: 那我再教你怎麼製作這兩種陷阱。
Then I will teach you how to set up these two traps.

S.FORM: Hay, aray! Matira i, mamanga'ay to kako a milepel to 'a'adopen.
Hay, aray! Matira i, mamanga'ay to kako a milepel to 'a'adopen.
S.PHON: ħaj araj matira i mamaŋaʡaj t[o|u] kak[o|u] a miɾəpəɾ t[o|u] ʡaʡa[ɬ|ɮ][o|u]pən
S.TRANSL: 好啊，太棒了！這樣我以後就會抓到獵物了。
Great! I will be able to catch the prey in the future.

S.FORM: Takaraw to ko semot no omah, Oli! Alaen ho^ ko kawkaw i 'ariri^, talaomah kita.
Takaraw to ko semot no omah, Oli! Alaen ho^ ko kawkaw i 'ariri^, talaomah kita.
S.PHON: takaraw t[o|u] k[o|u] səm[o|u]t n[o|u] [o|u]maħ [o|u]ɾi aɾaən ħ[o|u]ʔ k[o|u] kawkaw i ʡaririʔ taɾa[o|u]maħ kita
S.TRANSL: 田裡的草太長了，你去倉庫拿鐮刀，我們去田裡。
The grass in the fields is too tall. Go to the warehouse to take the sickle and let’s go to the fields.

S.FORM: Icowa^ a mateli^ koya kawkaw?
Icowa^ a mateli^ koya kawkaw?
S.PHON: iʦ[o|u]waʔ a matəɾiʔ k[o|u]ja kawkaw

S.FORM: I tatihi^ no fasolan, micomod kiso to 'ariri^ i, mamaneneng iso.
I tatihi^ no fasolan, micomod kiso to 'ariri^ i, mamaneneng iso.
S.PHON: i tatiħiʔ n[o|u] fas[o|u]ɾan miʦ[o|u]m[o|u][ɬ|ɮ] kis[o|u] t[o|u] ʡaririʔ i mamanənəŋ is[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 在圓簍的旁邊，你進去倉庫就會看到了。
It is next to the round basket. You will see it when you enter the warehouse.

S.FORM: Na'onen, matafala. Matalem kora kawkaw.
Na'onen, matafala. Matalem kora kawkaw.
S.PHON: naʡ[o|u]nən matafaɾa mataɾəm k[o|u]ra kawkaw
S.TRANSL: 小心拿，不要受傷。鐮刀很利。
Be careful and don’t get hurt. The sickle is very sharp.

S.FORM: Aka piripa' to tilo^ ako yo!
Aka piripa' to tilo^ ako yo!
S.PHON: aka piripaʡ t[o|u] tiɾ[o|u]ʔ ak[o|u] j[o|u]

S.FORM: Icowa^ koya tilo^ no miso?
Icowa^ koya tilo^ no miso?
S.PHON: iʦ[o|u]waʔ k[o|u]ja tiɾ[o|u]ʔ n[o|u] mis[o|u]

S.FORM: I kalaeno^ nora kilang ko tilo^ no mako.
I kalaeno^ nora kilang ko tilo^ no mako.
S.PHON: i kaɾaən[o|u]ʔ n[o|u]ra kiɾaŋ k[o|u] tiɾ[o|u]ʔ n[o|u] mak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我的陷阱在那棵樹的下面。
My trap is under that tree.

S.FORM: Nawiro maharate:ng ho^ iso?
Nawiro maharate:ng ho^ iso?
S.PHON: nawir[o|u] maħaratə:ŋ ħ[o|u]ʔ is[o|u]

S.FORM: Ira ko nipatokawan no mako itini, ora ko sakafan' ako to tilo^ no mako.
Ira ko nipatokawan no mako itini, ora ko sakafan' ako to tilo^ no mako.
S.PHON: ira k[o|u] nipat[o|u]kawan n[o|u] mak[o|u] itini [o|u]ra k[o|u] sakafanʡ ak[o|u] t[o|u] tiɾ[o|u]ʔ n[o|u] mak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我在這邊有做記號，我知道我的陷阱在哪裡。
I make a mark here, so I know where my trap is.

S.FORM: O rakar kinian, telien i 'alo^, o sapilepel to foting.
O rakar kinian, telien i 'alo^, o sapilepel to foting.
S.PHON: [o|u] rakar kinian təɾiən i ʡaɾ[o|u]ʔ [o|u] sapiɾəpəɾ t[o|u] f[o|u]tiŋ
S.TRANSL: 這是魚筌，我們放在溪邊用來捕魚。
This is a fish trap which we put beside the river for fishing.

S.FORM: Awaay ko rakar i tamiyanan, o tiked ko sapilepel niyam to foting.
Awaay ko rakar i tamiyanan, o tiked ko sapilepel niyam to foting.
S.PHON: awaaj k[o|u] rakar i tamijanan [o|u] tikə[ɬ|ɮ] k[o|u] sapiɾəpəɾ nijam t[o|u] f[o|u]tiŋ
S.TRANSL: 我們那邊沒有魚筌，我們都用釣竿抓魚。
We don’t have any fish traps there, so we catch fish with a fishing rod.

S.FORM: Caay ka fana' kako a mipatiked, pasifana' hato kako haw?
Caay ka fana' kako a mipatiked, pasifana' hato kako haw?
S.PHON: ʦaaj ka fanaʡ kak[o|u] a mipatikə[ɬ|ɮ] pasifanaʡ ħat[o|u] kak[o|u] ħaw
S.TRANSL: 我沒有用過釣竿，你下次教我好嗎?
I have never used a fishing rod before, would you mind teaching me next time?

S.FORM: Nga'ay to! Malahakelong kita a mipatiked anoci:la^.
Nga'ay to! Malahakelong kita a mipatiked anoci:la^.
S.PHON: ŋaʡaj t[o|u] maɾaħakəɾ[o|u]ŋ kita a mipatikə[ɬ|ɮ] an[o|u]ʦi:ɾaʔ
S.TRANSL: 好啊!我們下次一起去釣魚。
Sure! Let’s go fishing together next time.

S.FORM: Ano cilimaw, pasifana'en ako kiso a misanga' to rakar.
Ano cilimaw, pasifana'en ako kiso a misanga' to rakar.
S.PHON: an[o|u] ʦiɾimaw pasifanaʡən ak[o|u] kis[o|u] a misaŋaʡ t[o|u] rakar
S.TRANSL: I will teach you how to make a fish trap next time.

S.FORM: Mangangi^ ko tiked iso, alatek cimaalaay a foting! Tengtengen ari!
Mangangi^ ko tiked iso, alatek cimaalaay a foting! Tengtengen ari!
S.PHON: maŋaŋiʔ k[o|u] tikə[ɬ|ɮ] is[o|u] aɾatək ʦimaaɾaaj a f[o|u]tiŋ təŋtəŋən ari
S.TRANSL: 你的釣竿動了，是不是有魚上鉤了!你快拉起來!
I will teach you how to make a fish trap next time.

S.FORM: Talaen ho^! Tada tata'ak ko nikangangi^ no lonan. Itini kako a mitengteng to tiked, katayra ho^ kiso iti:raw a miala^ to salil.
Talaen ho^! Tada tata'ak ko nikangangi^ no lonan. Itini kako a mitengteng to tiked, katayra ho^ kiso iti:raw a miala^ to salil.
S.PHON: taɾaən ħ[o|u]ʔ ta[ɬ|ɮ]a tataʡak k[o|u] nikaŋaŋiʔ n[o|u] ɾ[o|u]nan itini kak[o|u] a mitəŋtəŋ t[o|u] tikə[ɬ|ɮ] katajra ħ[o|u]ʔ kis[o|u] iti:raw a miaɾaʔ t[o|u] saɾiɾ
S.TRANSL: 等等，船太晃了。我在這邊拉釣竿，你去那邊幫我拿網子來。
Wait, the ship is rolling heavily. I am here to pull the fishing rod and you should go there to grab me the net.

S.FORM: Tata! Taloma' to kita, palada'en ita ko 'alomanay.
Tata! Taloma' to kita, palada'en ita ko 'alomanay.
S.PHON: tata taɾ[o|u]maʡ t[o|u] kita paɾa[ɬ|ɮ]aʡən ita k[o|u] ʡaɾ[o|u]manaj
S.TRANSL: 我們快回去和大家分享。
Let’s go back immediately and share it with everyone.

S.FORM: Tayni^ to ko singsi^.
Tayni^ to ko singsi^.
S.PHON: tajniʔ t[o|u] k[o|u] siŋsiʔ

S.FORM: Aka to pisalama^, kamaro' to i kamaro'an.
Aka to pisalama^, kamaro' to i kamaro'an.
S.PHON: aka t[o|u] pisaɾamaʔ kamar[o|u]ʡ t[o|u] i kamar[o|u]ʡan
S.TRANSL: 不要再玩了，快坐在座位上。
Stop playing and quickly sit in your seat.

S.FORM: Maanen aca, maapac to kako!
Maanen aca, maapac to kako!
S.PHON: maanən aʦa maapaʦ t[o|u] kak[o|u]

S.FORM: Katahenay a talaloma'.
Katahenay a talaloma'.
S.PHON: kataħənaj a taɾaɾ[o|u]maʡ

S.FORM: Saka pina to no lipay i anini?
Saka pina to no lipay i anini?
S.PHON: saka pina t[o|u] n[o|u] ɾipaj i anini

S.FORM: Tinomaan i anini, o pipahanhan anocila^, mafolodaw kita a misalama^!
Tinomaan i anini, o pipahanhan anocila^, mafolodaw kita a misalama^!
S.PHON: tin[o|u]maan i anini [o|u] pipaħanħan an[o|u]ʦiɾaʔ maf[o|u]ɾ[o|u][ɬ|ɮ]aw kita a misaɾamaʔ
S.TRANSL: 今天星期五，明天放假，一起出去玩吧!
It's Friday today, we have a day off tomorrow. Let's go out and play together!

S.FORM: hayda! talalawac no 'alo^ kita.
hayda! talalawac no 'alo^ kita.
S.PHON: ħaj[ɬ|ɮ]a taɾaɾawaʦ n[o|u] ʡaɾ[o|u]ʔ kita
S.TRANSL: Great! Let's go to the riverside.

S.FORM: Saka pina no lipay i anocila^?
Saka pina no lipay i anocila^?
S.PHON: saka pina n[o|u] ɾipaj i an[o|u]ʦiɾaʔ
S.TRANSL: What day will it be tomorrow?

S.FORM: Tinoloan i anocila^, misalamaaaw kita to mali^ i herek no lahok anocila^.
Tinoloan i anocila^, misalamaaaw kita to mali^ i herek no lahok anocila^.
S.PHON: tin[o|u]ɾ[o|u]an i an[o|u]ʦiɾaʔ misaɾamaaaw kita t[o|u] maɾiʔ i ħərək n[o|u] ɾaħ[o|u]k an[o|u]ʦiɾaʔ
S.TRANSL: 明天星期三，我們明天下午去玩球吧。
Tomorrow will be Wednesday. Let's go play ball tomorrow afternoon!

S.FORM: Nimaan kiso anodafak?
Nimaan kiso anodafak?
S.PHON: nimaan kis[o|u] an[o|u][ɬ|ɮ]afak
S.TRANSL: What will you be doing tomorrow morning?

S.FORM: Tinopangan i anocila^, talakiyukay kako ato ci ina^.
Tinopangan i anocila^, talakiyokay kako ato ci ina^.
S.PHON: tin[o|u]paŋan i an[o|u]ʦiɾaʔ taɾakij[o|u]kaj kak[o|u] at[o|u] ʦi inaʔ
S.TRANSL: 明天是星期日，我要和媽媽去教會。
Tomorrow will be Sunday, I will be going to church with my mom.

S.FORM: Mamaan kiso?
Mamaan kiso?
S.PHON: mamaan kis[o|u]

S.FORM: Mangalay kako a mota',talakamisi'an ho kako.
Mangalay kako a mota',talakamisi'an ho kako.
S.PHON: maŋaɾaj kak[o|u] a m[o|u]taʡtaɾakamisiʡan ħ[o|u] kak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: I feel like vomiting. I need to go to the restroom.

S.FORM: Masinawar kako.
Masinawar kako.
S.PHON: masinawar kak[o|u]

S.FORM: Tihemoken a pahanhan kiso.
Tihemoken a pahanhan kiso.
S.PHON: tiħəm[o|u]kən a paħanħan kis[o|u]

S.FORM: Singsi^, adada^ ko tiyad ako, talakatomayi'an ho kako.
Singsi^, adada^ ko tiyad ako, talakatomayi'an ho kako.
S.PHON: siŋsiʔ a[ɬ|ɮ]a[ɬ|ɮ]aʔ k[o|u] tija[ɬ|ɮ] ak[o|u] taɾakat[o|u]majiʡan ħ[o|u] kak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 老師，我肚子痛，我要先去廁所。
Teacher, I have a stomachache. I need to go to the restroom.

S.FORM: Hayda, katahenay.
Hayda, katahenay.
S.PHON: ħaj[ɬ|ɮ]a kataħənaj

S.FORM: Manga'ay kako a monanaw haw?
Manga'ay kako a monanaw haw?
S.PHON: maŋaʡaj kak[o|u] a m[o|u]nanaw ħaw
S.TRANSL: May I go wash my hands?

S.FORM: Mangata^ to mipahanhan, nahoni to a tayra.
Mangata^ to mipahanhan, nahoni to a tayra.
S.PHON: maŋataʔ t[o|u] mipaħanħan naħ[o|u]ni t[o|u] a tajra
S.TRANSL: It's almost time for class to end. Wait a little longer.

S.FORM: Singsi^, adada^ ko tangal ako, mihifang kako i herek no lahok.
Singsi^, adada^ ko tangal ako, mihifang kako i herek no lahok.
S.PHON: siŋsiʔ a[ɬ|ɮ]a[ɬ|ɮ]aʔ k[o|u] taŋaɾ ak[o|u] miħifaŋ kak[o|u] i ħərək n[o|u] ɾaħ[o|u]k
S.TRANSL: 老師，我頭好痛，下午要請假。
It's almost time for class to end. Wait a little longer.

S.FORM: Hay, na'onen a taloma'.
Hay, na'onen a taloma'.
S.PHON: ħaj naʡ[o|u]nən a taɾ[o|u]maʡ
S.TRANSL: Okay, take care and go home.

S.FORM: Singsi^, mihifang kako i anocilaay a tinocayan, mipaising kako.
Singsi^, mihifang kako i anocilaay a tinocayan, mipaising kako.
S.PHON: siŋsiʔ miħifaŋ kak[o|u] i an[o|u]ʦiɾaaj a tin[o|u]ʦajan mipaisiŋ kak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 老師，我下禮拜一要請假，我要去看醫生。
Teacher, I need to take a sick leave next Monday. I have to see a doctor.

S.FORM: Hayda, na'onen ko tireng.
Hayda, na'onen ko tireng.
S.PHON: ħaj[ɬ|ɮ]a naʡ[o|u]nən k[o|u] tirəŋ

Icowa^ ci Panay?

Adada^ ko tiyad niira, i katomayi'an ciira.
S.PHON: a[ɬ|ɮ]a[ɬ|ɮ]aʔ k[o|u] tija[ɬ|ɮ] niira i kat[o|u]majiʡan ʦiira
S.TRANSL: She has a stomachache. She's in the restroom.

Icowa^ ci Kacaw?
S.PHON: iʦ[o|u]waʔ ʦi kaʦaw

Singsi^, adada^ ko pi'elokan ni Kacaw, mihifang ciira anini^.
S.PHON: siŋsiʔ a[ɬ|ɮ]a[ɬ|ɮ]aʔ k[o|u] piʡəɾ[o|u]kan ni kaʦaw miħifaŋ ʦiira aniniʔ
S.TRANSL: Teacher, Kacaw has a sore throat. She took a sick leave today.

S.FORM: Nawiro awaay a tayni^ ci Panay?
Nawiro awaay a tayni^ ci Panay?
S.PHON: nawir[o|u] awaaj a tajniʔ ʦi panaj

S.FORM: Malalisan ciira.
Malalisan ciira.

Painien ho ko tireng.
S.PHON: painiən ħ[o|u] k[o|u] tirəŋ

S.FORM: Ci Namoh Kolas han ko ngangan no mako, moetepay to ko mihecaan i matini^.
Ci Namoh Kolas han ko ngangan no mako, moetepay to ko mihecaan i matini^.
S.PHON: ʦi nam[o|u]ħ k[o|u]ɾas ħan k[o|u] ŋaŋan n[o|u] mak[o|u] m[o|u]ətəpaj t[o|u] k[o|u] miħəʦaan i matiniʔ
S.TRANSL: My name is Namoh Kolas, and I’m 10 years old.

S.FORM: Cima han ko ngangan no miso?
Cima han ko ngangan no miso?
S.PHON: ʦima ħan k[o|u] ŋaŋan n[o|u] mis[o|u]

Ci Foting Kolas han kako.

O wawa^ no icowaay a finacadan kiso?

S.TRANSL: What ethnic group are you from?

S.FORM: O wawa^ no Pangcah kako.
O wawa^ no Pangcah kako.
S.PHON: [o|u] wawaʔ n[o|u] paŋʦaħ kak[o|u]

S.FORM: O Pangcah a ma'emin ko laloma'an no miso haw?
O Pangcah a ma'emin ko laloma'an no miso haw?
S.PHON: [o|u] paŋʦaħ a maʡəmin k[o|u] ɾaɾ[o|u]maʡan n[o|u] mis[o|u] ħaw
S.TRANSL: 你的家人都是原住民嗎?
Are all your family members indigenous?

S.FORM: Hay, O Pangcah a ma'emin ko laloma'an no niyam.
Hay, O Pangcah a ma'emin ko laloma'an no niyam.
S.PHON: ħaj [o|u] paŋʦaħ a maʡəmin k[o|u] ɾaɾ[o|u]maʡan n[o|u] nijam
S.TRANSL: 是的，我們全家都是阿美族人。
Yes, my whole family is Amis.

S.FORM: O Pangcah a ma'emin ko laloma'an no miso haw?
O Pangcah a ma'emin ko laloma'an no miso haw?
S.PHON: [o|u] paŋʦaħ a maʡəmin k[o|u] ɾaɾ[o|u]maʡan n[o|u] mis[o|u] ħaw
S.TRANSL: 你的家人都是原住民嗎?
Are all your family members indigenous?

S.FORM: tala soraratan aca, cilosid kako a tayraan.
tala soraratan aca, cilosid kako a tayraan.
S.PHON: taɾa s[o|u]raratan aʦa ʦiɾ[o|u]si[ɬ|ɮ] kak[o|u] a tajraan
S.TRANSL: Onak:那去聚會所好了，我會穿族服去。
Then let’s go to the community center. I’ll wear folk costume.

S.FORM: Makapah a macerak ko sakola no niyaro' niyam, tayni hato i kacerakan no hana^ a mikilim i takowanan!
Makapah a macerak ko sakola no niyaro' niyam, tayni hato i kacerakan no hana^ a mikilim i takowanan!
S.PHON: makapaħ a maʦərak k[o|u] sak[o|u]ɾa n[o|u] nijar[o|u]ʡ nijam tajni ħat[o|u] i kaʦərakan n[o|u] ħanaʔ a mikiɾim i tak[o|u]wanan
S.TRANSL: Sera:我們部落的櫻花盛開很漂亮。等花開的時候你來找我吧!
The cherry blossoms in our tribe are beautiful when they bloom. Come find me when the flowers bloom!

S.FORM: Talae:n aca i kacanglahan, tada halafin.
Talae:n aca i kacanglahan, tada halafin.
S.PHON: taɾaə:n aʦa i kaʦaŋɾaħan ta[ɬ|ɮ]a ħaɾafin
S.TRANSL: Onak:那要等到春天，太久了吧!
That would have to wait until spring. It’s too late, isn’t it?

S.FORM: Ano matira, piilisinan aca a tayni kiso.
Ano matira, piilisinan aca a tayni kiso.
S.PHON: an[o|u] matira piiɾisinan aʦa a tajni kis[o|u]
S.TRANSL: Sera:那你豐年祭的時候來吧!
Then come during our Harvest Festival!

S.FORM: Hayda! mihamham kako!
Hayda! mihamham kako!
S.PHON: ħaj[ɬ|ɮ]a miħamħam kak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: Alright! I’m looking forward to it!

S.FORM: Milicay ho, hacowa kiso a malinah a tala niyaro'?
Milicay ho, hacowa kiso a malinah a tala niyaro'?
S.PHON: miɾiʦaj ħ[o|u] ħaʦ[o|u]wa kis[o|u] a maɾinaħ a taɾa nijar[o|u]ʡ
S.TRANSL: Sera:請問你何時要搬回部落生活?
May I ask why you decided to move back to the tribe?

S.FORM: Malasingsi^ to kako ta taloma'.
Malasingsi^ to kako ta taloma'.
S.PHON: maɾasiŋsiʔ t[o|u] kak[o|u] ta taɾ[o|u]maʡ
S.TRANSL: I want to return to teach at the local school.

S.FORM: Nawiro cai ka i tokay a malasingsi^?
Nawiro cai ka i tokay a malasingsi^?
S.PHON: nawir[o|u] ʦai ka i t[o|u]kaj a maɾasiŋsiʔ
S.TRANSL: Sera:為甚麼不在都市當老師?
Why not teach in the city?

S.FORM: Ma'ilol kako to niyaro', mangalay kako a paco'ay to niyaro' niyam.
Ma'ilol kako to niyaro', mangalay kako a paco'ay to niyaro' niyam.
S.PHON: maʡiɾ[o|u]ɾ kak[o|u] t[o|u] nijar[o|u]ʡ maŋaɾaj kak[o|u] a paʦ[o|u]ʡaj t[o|u] nijar[o|u]ʡ nijam
S.TRANSL: Onak:因為我懷念我的故鄉，希望能回饋部落。
Because I miss my hometown and I also want to give back to the tribe.

S.FORM: Mafana' kiso a mitenoon, cima ko pasifana'ay kisowanan?
Mafana' kiso a mitenoon, cima ko pasifana'ay kisowanan?
S.PHON: mafanaʡ kis[o|u] a mitən[o|u][o|u]n ʦima k[o|u] pasifanaʡaj kis[o|u]wanan
S.TRANSL: Onak:你很會織布，是誰教你的?
You’re very skilled at weaving, who taught you?

S.FORM: Ci ama ako, o mafana;'ay a mitenoon ciira i niyaro' no niyam.
Ci ama ako, o mafana;'ay a mitenoon ciira i niyaro' no niyam.
S.PHON: ʦi ama ak[o|u] [o|u] mafanaʡaj a mitən[o|u][o|u]n ʦiira i nijar[o|u]ʡ n[o|u] nijam
S.TRANSL: Sera:是我的奶奶，她是我們部落最會織布的人。
It was my grandmother, she is the most skilled weaver in our tribe.

S.FORM: Nawiro mangalay a minanam a mitenoon kiso?
Nawiro mangalay a minanam a mitenoon kiso?
S.PHON: nawir[o|u] maŋaɾaj a minanam a mitən[o|u][o|u]n kis[o|u]
S.TRANSL: How did you develop an interest in learning weaving?

S.FORM: O serangawan no mita ko tenoon, mangalay kako a misarayray to serangawan.
O serangawan no mita ko tenoon, mangalay kako a misarayray to serangawan.
S.PHON: [o|u] səraŋawan n[o|u] mita k[o|u] tən[o|u][o|u]n maŋaɾaj kak[o|u] a misarajraj t[o|u] səraŋawan
S.TRANSL: Sera:織布是我們的文化，我想要讓文化延續。
Weaving is a part of our culture, and I want to ensure its continuity.

S.FORM: kaeso' 'inipen kina eraw.
kaeso' 'inipen kina eraw.
S.PHON: kaəs[o|u]ʡ ʡinipən kina əraw

S.FORM: Nisaerawan no mako yo!
Nisaerawan no mako yo!
S.PHON: nisaərawan n[o|u] mak[o|u] j[o|u]

S.FORM: Watah ko fana' iso, halafin a misaeraw haw?
Watah ko fana' iso, halafin a misaeraw haw?
S.PHON: wataħ k[o|u] fanaʡ is[o|u] ħaɾafin a misaəraw ħaw
S.TRANSL: Onak:你真厲害，這要釀很久嗎?
You’re really talented. Does it take a long time to make?

S.FORM: Cai, cecay a lipay maherek to , cacaken ho ko hakhak ato hemay, ta diwadiw han a mipacamol to tomod, ta fa^cal to paroen i 'atomo.
Cai, cecay a lipay maherek to , cacaken ho ko hakhak ato hemay, ta diwadiw han a mipacamol to tomod, ta fa^cal to paroen i 'atomo.
S.PHON: ʦai ʦəʦaj a ɾipaj maħərək t[o|u] ʦaʦakən ħ[o|u] k[o|u] ħakħak at[o|u] ħəmaj ta [ɬ|ɮ]iwa[ɬ|ɮ]iw ħan a mipaʦam[o|u]ɾ t[o|u] t[o|u]m[o|u][ɬ|ɮ] ta faʔʦaɾ t[o|u] par[o|u]ən i ʡat[o|u]m[o|u]
S.TRANSL: Sera:不用，大約一周就好了。把糯米和白米先蒸熟，再加入麴粉一起拌勻，就可以裝到甕裡了。
No, it only takes about a week. After steaming the sticky rice and white rice, we mix it with yeast powder, and then it can be stored in a jar.

S.FORM: O maan ko nipacakayan iso?
O maan ko nipacakayan iso?
S.PHON: [o|u] maan k[o|u] nipaʦakajan is[o|u]

S.FORM: Ira ko daydam ato lokiyo, o nipalomaan no mako a maemin.
Ira ko daydam ato lokiyo, o nipalomaan no mako a maemin.
S.PHON: ira k[o|u] [ɬ|ɮ]aj[ɬ|ɮ]am at[o|u] ɾ[o|u]kij[o|u] [o|u] nipaɾ[o|u]maan n[o|u] mak[o|u] a maəmin
S.TRANSL: Kamih:我這裡有辣椒和蕗蕎，都是我自己種的喔!
I have chili and lokiy, both grown by myself!

S.FORM: Ano hatosa^ han ako a micakay ri, pina^ ko 'aca^?
Ano hatosa^ han ako a micakay ri, pina^ ko 'aca^?
S.PHON: an[o|u] ħat[o|u]saʔ ħan ak[o|u] a miʦakaj ri pinaʔ k[o|u] ʡaʦaʔ

S.FORM: Tosa^ li'an ira ko lima^ polo' a mapolong.
Tosa^ li'an ira ko lima^ polo' a mapolong.
S.PHON: t[o|u]saʔ ɾiʡan ira k[o|u] ɾimaʔ p[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ʡ a map[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ŋ

S.FORM: Maolah kako kina fodoy, pina^ ko 'aca^?
Maolah kako kina fodoy, pina^ ko 'aca^?
S.PHON: ma[o|u]ɾaħ kak[o|u] kina f[o|u][ɬ|ɮ][o|u]j pinaʔ k[o|u] ʡaʦaʔ
S.TRANSL: Piyaw:我喜歡這件衣服，多少錢?
I like this piece of clothing. How much is it?

S.FORM: Lima^ li'an kinian.
Lima^ li'an kinian.
S.PHON: ɾimaʔ ɾiʡan kinian

S.FORM: Watah ka'atekes, keroren to mamang rey?
Watah ka'atekes, keroren to mamang rey?
S.PHON: wataħ kaʡatəkəs kər[o|u]rən t[o|u] mamaŋ rəj
S.TRANSL: It’s too expensive. Can’t you lower the price a bit?

S.FORM: Tatiih, ano keroren haca, awa ko lifon no mako.
Tatiih, ano keroren haca, awa ko lifon no mako.
S.PHON: tatiiħ an[o|u] kər[o|u]rən ħaʦa awa k[o|u] ɾif[o|u]n n[o|u] mak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: No, if I lower it further, I’ll lose money.

S.FORM: Hayda, yana kohetingay a fodoy to cecay han ako.
Hayda, yana kohetingay a fodoy to cecay han ako.
S.PHON: ħaj[ɬ|ɮ]a jana k[o|u]ħətiŋaj a f[o|u][ɬ|ɮ][o|u]j t[o|u] ʦəʦaj ħan ak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: Piyaw:好吧!那我要一件黑色的衣服。
Alright then, I’ll take a black piece of clothing.

S.FORM: Nianay a po'ot ato sioy han ako.
Nianay a po'ot ato sioy han ako.
S.PHON: nianaj a p[o|u]ʡ[o|u]t at[o|u] si[o|u]j ħan ak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: Piyaw:我要這把刀和這個鍋子。
I want this knife and this pot.

S.FORM: Tosa^ patek pida^ a mapolong, nakamayan no mako kinian, mihusyu kako caay kalales.
Tosa^ patek pida^ a mapolong, nakamayan no mako kinian, mihosyo kako caay kalales.
S.PHON: t[o|u]saʔ patək pi[ɬ|ɮ]aʔ a map[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ŋ nakamajan n[o|u] mak[o|u] kinian miħ[o|u]sj[o|u] kak[o|u] ʦaaj kaɾaɾəs
S.TRANSL: Kamih:總共2000元，這是我自己手工打造的，保證可以用很久。
It’s a total of 2000 dollars. I handmade these, and they are guaranteed to last a long time.

S.FORM: Painien ako ko hanghang a tayni micakay, maedeng kaemihen haca to mamang haw?
Painien ako ko hanghang a tayni micakay, maedeng kaemihen haca to mamang haw?
S.PHON: painiən ak[o|u] k[o|u] ħaŋħaŋ a tajni miʦakaj maə[ɬ|ɮ]əŋ kaəmiħən ħaʦa t[o|u] mamaŋ ħaw
S.TRANSL: Piyaw:我介紹朋友來買，可以再便宜一些嗎?
I’ll introduce my friend to buy. Can you give a further discount?

S.FORM: Hayda, keroren ako to tosa^ polo' a pasintu.
Hayda, keroren ako to tosa^ polo' a pasinto.
S.PHON: ħaj[ɬ|ɮ]a kər[o|u]rən ak[o|u] t[o|u] t[o|u]saʔ p[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ʡ a pasint[o|u]
S.TRANSL: Alright! I’ll give you a 20% discount.

S.FORM: katayni a minengneng yo! ira ko nipacakayan to fodoy ato tamohong.
katayni a minengneng yo! ira ko nipacakayan to fodoy ato tamohong.
S.PHON: katajni a minəŋnəŋ j[o|u] ira k[o|u] nipaʦakajan t[o|u] f[o|u][ɬ|ɮ][o|u]j at[o|u] tam[o|u]ħ[o|u]ŋ
S.TRANSL: Piyaw:來看看喔!衣服帽子都有賣。
Come and take a look! We sell clothes and hats.

S.FORM: Pina ko 'aca^ no fodoy?
Pina ko 'aca^ no fodoy?
S.PHON: pina k[o|u] ʡaʦaʔ n[o|u] f[o|u][ɬ|ɮ][o|u]j

S.FORM: Tolo^ li'an ira ko lima^ polo' pida^ ko cecay a fafodoyan, cecay patek pida^ ko tolo^.
Tolo^ li'an ira ko lima^ polo' pida^ ko cecay a fafodoyan, cecay patek pida^ ko tolo^.
S.PHON: t[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ʔ ɾiʡan ira k[o|u] ɾimaʔ p[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ʡ pi[ɬ|ɮ]aʔ k[o|u] ʦəʦaj a faf[o|u][ɬ|ɮ][o|u]jan ʦəʦaj patək pi[ɬ|ɮ]aʔ k[o|u] t[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ʔ
S.TRANSL: One piece of clothing is 350 dollars, three pieces for 1000 dollars.

S.FORM: Cecayen aca^ ako a micakay, ka o faelohay ko pafelien kako.
Cecayen aca^ ako a micakay, ka o faelohay ko pafelien kako.
S.PHON: ʦəʦajən aʦaʔ ak[o|u] a miʦakaj ka [o|u] faəɾ[o|u]ħaj k[o|u] pafəɾiən kak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: Kamih:我買一件就好，請給我新的。
I’ll just buy one piece, please give me a new one.

S.FORM: Nga'ay ho, mangalay kako a micakay to hakhak ato siraw.
Nga'ay ho, mangalay kako a micakay to hakhak ato siraw.
S.PHON: ŋaʡaj ħ[o|u] maŋaɾaj kak[o|u] a miʦakaj t[o|u] ħakħak at[o|u] siraw
S.TRANSL: Kamih:你好，我想要買糯米飯和鹹豬肉。
Hello, I would like to buy sticky rice and braised pork with maqaw pepper.

S.FORM: Ma'emin to a mapacakay ko hakhak, ira ho ko nisaepangan to tana', mangalay kiso a micakay haw?
Ma'emin to a mapacakay ko hakhak, ira ho ko nisaepangan to tana', mangalay kiso a micakay haw?
S.PHON: maʡəmin t[o|u] a mapaʦakaj k[o|u] ħakħak ira ħ[o|u] k[o|u] nisaəpaŋan t[o|u] tanaʡ maŋaɾaj kis[o|u] a miʦakaj ħaw
S.TRANSL: Piyaw:糯米飯賣完了。我還有刺蔥麵包，你要買嗎?
The rice is sold out. I have tana pancakes, would you like to buy them?

S.FORM: Hayda^, pafelien kako to cecay, cilacila to kako a micakay to hemay.
Hayda^, pafelien kako to cecay, cilacila to kako a micakay to hemay.
S.PHON: ħaj[ɬ|ɮ]aʔ pafəɾiən kak[o|u] t[o|u] ʦəʦaj ʦiɾaʦiɾa t[o|u] kak[o|u] a miʦakaj t[o|u] ħəmaj
S.TRANSL: Kamih:好吧!請給我一份，我下次再來買飯。
Alright, please give me one. I’ll come back next time to buy rice.

S.FORM: Hayda^, padangen ako kiso a miparo^ i tisakiay, lima^ polo' pida^ a hatini.
Hayda^, padangen ako kiso a miparo^ i tisakiay, lima^ polo' pida^ a hatini.
S.PHON: ħaj[ɬ|ɮ]aʔ pa[ɬ|ɮ]aŋən ak[o|u] kis[o|u] a mipar[o|u]ʔ i tisakiaj ɾimaʔ p[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ʡ pi[ɬ|ɮ]aʔ a ħatini
S.TRANSL: Piyaw:好，我幫你用袋子裝起來，這樣50元。
Okay, I’ll pack it in a bag for you. That’ll be 50 dollars.
